label: 1.3 Beta
native_mac_validation_scope: Exact combined archive on hosted Mac ARM64 and Intel: 357 feature tests and 50 required cases with zero skips, fresh-App installation, synthetic portrait/landscape exports, source audio/captions, missing-pip recovery and restart persistence passed. Physical UI, human listening, model inference and transcription were not performed.

github_release.package_bytes_basis: Exact source-bound archives tested in run 42965402773; immutable staging nbymjtivwx is checksum-pinned and independently checked by ordinary release gates before publication.

mac.native_validation_basis: The exact tested combined archive; open its mac folder. No separate Mac rebuild.

release_summary: Neutral gray light-mode workspace and dialogs preserve the media preview and dark mode. Automatic Hebrew refinement uses only an already-cached local model under language, duration and hardware gates, preserving the original transcript on weak output. Mixed Hebrew-English ASS presentation is corrected without changing source text or SRT. Prior studio and source-editing features remain included.
known_limitations: The Windows source-beta setup ran on a configured hosted runner. Clean-OS and prerequisite installation and the packaged batch launcher were not tested.
Mac ARM64 and Intel automated checks passed. Physical-device UI, Finder, Gatekeeper, Safari and human listening remain unverified.
No speech model or transcription was run. Hebrew transcription accuracy, semantic editing and automatic speaker-linked framing remain unfinished and need review.
Process restart is not an OS reboot. Windows SmartScreen, quarantine and physical-device acceptance remain unverified.
Existing silent overlays preserve their saved setting. Select the clip and enable Include source sound; also check clip/group mute and gain.
Picture speed changes only the image; sound retains its normal clock from Source in. Review sync before publishing.

Targeted headless Chromium checks covered gray Home/editor workspaces, export-dialog reopening, light/dark switching, persistence and compact Home. Actual 200% browser zoom and physical-device UI acceptance remain unverified.

The website gallery remains archival: workspace images from 19 October 2026, Projects/export from 15 October, and an unrecorded AI setup capture date. Targeted fresh gray-mode QA captures were inspected separately; this is not a complete new product gallery.
Physical Chrome/manual browser acceptance and representative human listening were not performed; automated and headless checks do not replace them.
